name: tech.aspid.fasttools
description: Unity tools to cut boilerplate — source-generated ProfilerMarkers, serializable type/enum systems, SerializeReference tooling and a fluent UIToolkit API.

samples.description: Press Play in Types.unity to spawn enemies of the class and pattern picked on the Spawner, switch the pattern while they move, and switch a placed enemy's class in place. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/types

Pick the class of each [SerializeReference] weapon on Loadout.asset and switch it without losing Damage, then rename a class and repair the broken references. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/serialize-references

Press Play in EnumValues.unity: each lane takes its color and its runner's speed from the tables on Surface Rules, and edits to the tables show at once. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/enum-values

Open the Profiler and press Play in ProfilerMarkers.unity to see the nested markers that this.Marker() adds to a flock simulation. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/profiler-markers

Open Tools → Aspid 🐍 → FastTools → Samples → Ability Catalog: an editor window built in code with the fluent UI Toolkit and SerializedProperty extensions. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/editor-tools
